description: 5 exemplars (1 de) + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored under road-to-a-component-taxonomy-we-follow-but-never-force, whose diff edits this skill's placement section — check_routing_coverage requires a corpus for every skill a diff touches, so this file is the gate's own remedy rather than a coverage push. Exemplars cover the five shapes the skill decides: splitting an over-loaded component, composition vs inheritance, the slot contract, the controlled/uncontrolled axis, and where a new component belongs under a project's own granularity taxonomy. The near-misses are the three surfaces whose vocabulary overlaps hardest and each routes elsewhere; the counterexamples guard over-triggering on component words with no component to shape.

queries.q: this Table component has grown to 19 props — how should I split it?
should the Dialog share behavior by composition or by extending a base class?
design the slot contract for our Card so consumers can replace the header
should this Combobox be controlled or uncontrolled, and what is the prop API?
wir gliedern Komponenten in primitives/patterns/features — wo gehört eine neue Checkout-Hülle hin?
inventory which components this project already owns before we build anything
